Alex: Heads-up — I'm starting bring-up for v2p0-int4 on user chat. Want to avoid the oscillation we saw last quarter when traffic hit the kv warmup coldpath. Thinking of a rotational-lease queue gate that staggers traffic across slices and enforces a per-slice holdback if telemetry spikes. Thoughts?
Maya: +1 on avoiding oscillation. can you sketch the gating rules? curious how aggressive the holdback TTL is.
Alex: Rough idea: 1) seed 1% traffic, 2) after 10k requests evaluate seq-metrics over 1h window, 3) if latency_p95 > baseline*1.25 OR hallucination_rate delta > 2ppt OR prompt_mrr drops > 1.5% then move slice to holdback and start a rotational lease countdown (default 30m).
Ryan: Are we measuring kv_warmup_rate separately? that was the main signal that caused cache pressure.
Alex: yes — include kv_warmup_rate < 0.6 as a success signal. also track entropy_delta to catch non-degrading noise shifts.
Maya: How do leases rotate? fixed-time windows or backoff? need hysteresis to prevent flip-flop.
Alex: Plan is exponential backoff on reattempts: 30m -> 1h -> 3h. release only if trailing-window metrics return to within thresholds for two consecutive windows.
monitoring-bot: alert: slice chat-cohort-17 latency_p95 spike detected (+38%) at 1772223500 — auto-held by gate.
Ryan: Nice. For A/B analysis, we should shadow 10% additional traffic to a replica for concordance checks, plus run a small contrastive eval on stored prompts to confirm factuality delta.
Maya: Agree. Also want a safety-net policy: if overall system capacity drops below 75% (bgutilization metric) then immediately throttle all promotions and move to global holdback.
Alex: Good call. I'll add a capacity clause. Also adding a lightweight rollout policy JSON to the config repo. Example: 
```json
{
  "seed_pct": 1,
  "expand_window_requests": 10000,
  "metrics": {
    "latency_p95_ratio": 1.25,
    "hallucination_delta_pp": 2.0,
    "prompt_mrr_drop_pct": 1.5,
    "kv_warmup_min": 0.6
  },
  "lease_backoff_minutes": [30,60,180],
  "holdback_reason_tags": ["latency", "hallucination", "mrr_drop", "kv_cold"]
}
```
Maya: That looks good. Can you make the rollout policy include the telemetry stream names and the eval job id it should run for contrastive checks?
Alex: Yep — will push a PR with stream refs and a default eval job (eval-job/small-contrastive-2026-03). Assigning myself to implement gate logic and to add a dashboard slice. @Ryan can you take the concordance eval harness?
Ryan: On it. I'll wire the shadow traffic and run a dry-run tomorrow morning.
Alex: Thanks. If anyone sees oscillation during dry-run, ping #eng-ml and I'll pause. :thumbsup:
